items.title: UK financial regulators propose new cyber resilience guidance
items.summary: UK financial watchdogs have laid out proposed guidance on cyber resilience amid rising artificial intelligence risks.

items.title: Aberdeen completes real estate fund merger
items.summary: Aberdeen Investments has combined its Real Estate and Real Estate Feeder funds into a single strategy.

items.title: US legal services group ProLegal joins MGAs' trade body ahead of UK market entry
items.summary: American firm ProLegal has joined the Managing General Agents Association to launch After the Event legal insurance in England and Wales in 2027.

items.title: GTA VI launch highlights shared digital infrastructure risks for cyber insurers
items.summary: The global launch of Grand Theft Auto VI highlights the interconnected digital infrastructure risks faced by insurers covering business interruption.

items.title: K2 Insurance Services launches Summit Risk Partners as registered Lloyd’s broker
items.summary: Specialist broking house Summit Risk Partners has opened for business in London and Hamburg to serve the delegated authority and programme sector.

items.title: Ransomware attacks jump 38% in third quarter
items.summary: Ransomware incidents increased by 38% in the third quarter compared to the previous quarter, data from Beazley Security shows.
